title: The First Verbs
label: ch:first-verbs
canDo: I can build short present-tense Sanskrit sentences with the chapter's first verbs.

payoff.summary: Complete SA-C05-practice, the canonical closing checkpoint, and demonstrate the chapter promise: build short present-tense Sanskrit sentences with the chapter's first verbs; then name the roots vad, vas and kṛ, unpack saṁskṛta, hear sandhi, and pick out य and ◌ृ.
payoff.note: SA-C05-practice assesses fourteen of the chapter's fifteen atoms, including य and ◌ृ (reached through SA-S205-vowel-sign-vocalic-r, sequence 281). The letter अ (SA-SCRIPT-RECOG-03) is introduced by SA-S03-letter-a at sequence 301, after this checkpoint, so it is not assessed here.
